brief:
Settlers stormed three Palestinian villages south of Nablus in the northern West Bank early Tuesday morning, Shehab Wire reported. Local sources identified the targeted communities as Awarta, Osarin, and Sarra. The groups conducted operations across the villages during the pre-dawn hours, according to the account.

The incident marks the latest in a series of settler incursions into Palestinian-controlled areas of the West Bank. Such raids have become frequent occurrences in the region, often resulting in property damage and confrontations with Palestinian residents. The exact nature of the settlers' activities during Tuesday's operation was not immediately detailed in available reports.
title: Settlers raid three villages south of Nablus at dawn
